name: The Other Gnostic Codices
translation: Selected excerpts adapted from public-domain and early translations (after F.C. Burkitt, 1904; G.R.S. Mead, 1921; the Berlin Codex)
note: Gnostic works that survived outside the Nag Hammadi library: the Gospel of Mary from the Berlin Codex, the Hymn of the Pearl from the Acts of Thomas, and the great system of Pistis Sophia.
